sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Research Queries (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC Research Queries directory supplies the Orphan Well Query index label, launch relationship, monthly update label, access caution, and global online-query limitation.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the directory only to preserve the official route, label, update statement, source identity, access caution, and limitation; it does not treat a result as authoritative, legally effective, complete, connected to private property, or sufficient for a downstream conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, About Oil & Gas Data Queries (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official About Oil & Gas Data Queries page supplies bounded system context for separately named EWA routes and explains that each query is one slice of the larger Oil and Gas System.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses that context only to keep routes separate and does not infer record equivalence, orphan-well status, operator status, compliance, plugging responsibility, or legal effect.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Oil & Gas Data Query menu (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official Oil & Gas Data Query menu displays Orphan Well Query and neighboring EWA systems as separate launch routes.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records the menu label and route separation only; a shared well, operator, lease, field, county, district, or API label does not establish that separate query systems describe the same record or private interest.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Orphan Well Query (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The launched official application supplies the Orphan Well Query HTML title and visible heading, well-type, district, lease-or-well-ID, county, field, operator, and API criteria labels, plus exact execution route.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article preserves labels and records selected criteria and displayed state without submitting, reproducing, or interpreting a property-specific result.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Orphan Well Query Help (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official Orphan Well help table of contents supplies the source-defined separation among query, results, download, and contact-help pages.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records only help navigation used during one attempt and does not infer a substantive status from opening a help route.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Orphan Well Query How To (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official How To page supplies oil, gas, or both; district; lease or gas-well ID; field; operator; and selector search paths, plus submit and return navigation.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records only the path and source-displayed instructions used in one attempt and does not turn a criterion, selector, or result into an orphan-well, compliance, plugging, or property conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Orphan Well Query About (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official About page supplies the source description of the query, source-defined scope, monthly update statement, and names of result information.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article treats those items only as source descriptions and does not interpret the source definition, months inactive, operator, lease, well, field, county, district, compliance, condition, or plugging significance.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Orphan Well Query Results Help (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official results help supplies bounded result-column, pagination, sorting, detail-link, tab, and download context.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records the displayed result state and retained-reference provenance only and does not interpret an orphan-well category, operator, well status, inactive period, plugging information, or downstream relationship.
